title: Moose Lodge | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the lodge combines rustic elegance with modern amenities to ensure a comfortable and luxurious stay. With spacious living areas adorned with log furniture and a chic reclaimed wood wall, the home creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. It features a fully stocked kitchen with state-of-the-art appliances, including a Keurig coffee maker, ensuring guests have everything they need to create memorable meals. The entertainment options are vast, with a lower level equipped with a second kitchen, foosball, and pool table, alongside a large TV area perfect for keeping children entertained. Outdoors, the property boasts an incredible entertainment patio with a pond, waterfalls, and a covered kitchen, alongside a large dining area perfect for al fresco meals. The luxurious touch of an extra-deep five-person Nordic Spa hot tub on the deck offers a perfect relaxation spot, completing the experience of ultimate comfort and exclusive leisure in this stunning mountain retreat.
